# Design Notes: Bonquet (ColorLib Restauco)

## Reference Mapping

- **Source Template**: Restauco (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/restauco/`)
- **Live Preview**: `https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/restauco/`
- **Recreated App**: `apps/bonquet` (`@free-react-templates/bonquet`)
- **Subdomain**: `bonquet.free.componentdock.com`

## Design System & Tokens

- **Palette**:
  - Primary Brand Coral/Orange: `#FE5F41`
  - Hero Background: `#FFF4F2` (soft peach white)
  - Footer Background: `#FFF7F3` (warm cream)
  - Dark Brown Text: `#4D312C`
- **Typography**:
  - Body: Google Fonts `Raleway` (`font-family: "Raleway", sans-serif`)
  - Headings/Buttons: Google Fonts `Mitr` (`font-family: "Mitr", sans-serif`)
- **Shapes**:
  - Buttons: Pill-shaped (`rounded-full`), solid primary with white text or bordered variant with coral stroke.
- **Imagery**: Unsplash / Picsum Photos deterministic seeds (`https://picsum.photos/seed/bonquet-...`).
- **Footer Attribution**: Must link `https://www.componentdock.com/` ("Component Dock").
